value.rationale: This is the complete natural labelled minimal-transversal antichain of cycles, not a scalar minimum. Exact cubic-many three-vertex irredundant covers coexist with linearly-many optimum size-2 sets, and purity fails at n=9, returns at n=10, then fails for all n>=11. The phenomenon answers a motivated upper/lower minimal-hitting-size and redundancy question, without assuming a downstream theorem.
